item.title: The Outsized Shadow: Why 5% of AI Users Are Your Biggest Security Risk
item.summary: Big security risks come in small packages. While enterprise security teams focus on policing the proliferation of employees using ChatGPT and Claude for quick drafting tasks, a more urgent threat is posed by a handful of AI super-adopters who are quietly hardcoding unvetted tools into critical business operations.
